newsitem.title: USA: Clinton celebrates balanced budget with night out.
newsitem.headline: Clinton celebrates balanced budget with night out.

text.p: President Clinton celebrated the signing of the balanced-budget law by enjoying a rare evening out Tuesday, listening to singer Kim Richey at a country music club in Alexandria, Va.

Clinton and his wife, Hillary Rodham Clinton, accompanied by Vice President Al Gore and his wife, Tipper Gore, sat directly in front of the stage at the Birchmere club, enjoying a big meal of burgers, pizzas and other traditional American fare.

Richey, a folksy singer who reminds some listeners of '60s star Judy Collins, is a friend of the vice president's, and the evening out was apparently his idea, a White House spokeswoman told reporters.
Nearly 400 people paid $16.50 each to hear Richey and her five-piece band at the Birchmere, a popular suburban nightspot with a large bar area, pool tables and bright blue checkered tablecloths.
